name: legal-bench_cat1_cite_retrieval
description: A legal citation retrieval benchmark that measures a model's ability to find and rank relevant legal citations given a legal prompt or case text. It evaluates retrieval and ranking performance in the legal domain, focusing on precision of returned citations and recall of relevant precedents. Useful for assessing legal-AI systems' research and retrieval components.
reputation: A niche research benchmark used in legal-ML retrieval work but not yet a widely adopted community standard.
